name: Protection from Arrows, Greater
body:
School abjuration; Level alchemist 4, bloodrager 4, psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, spiritualist 4, summoner/unchained summoner 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature
Duration 10 minutes/level or until discharged
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like protection from arrows except as noted above. Additionally, if damage from a ranged attack is completely negated by the damage reduction gained from this spell the projectile is sent flying back towards the attacker.

You make a ranged attack roll using your caster level in place of your base attack bonus and using the highest of your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifiers in place of your Dexterity modifier. If the attack hits it deals damage as appropriate for a weapon of its type plus an amount of damage equal to the ability score modifier you used on the attack roll.
